notes: A job is marked Wrapped up once every box on the progress rail is ticked. There was no route to that stage at all before except cancelling the job, so anything you had finished and invoiced sat in the on-the-go list for ever. The brown Invoice chip is gone with it: ticking the rail never touched the invoice status, so the nudge kept firing on a job you had already dealt with. Nothing needing attention is raised on a job whose rail is complete. It works either way round - tick the Invoice box by hand for one you settled outside the app, or mark it Paid in the Money tab and the box ticks itself - and untick anything and the job reopens exactly as it was.
